name: Kitsune, Dragon's Daughter — "two other target creatures controlled by different players" lists every creature but Kitsune, and B only the other player's
notes: "Whenever Kitsune enters or deals combat damage to a player, you may exchange control of two other target creatures controlled by different players." Found by the exchange-control audit unit (2026-11-18). The parser read "two target …" but not "two other target …", so the type text stayed "two other target creatures", which nothing matches: both lists were empty. Now the type is "creatures" and params.exchangeOtherThanSource keeps Kitsune out of both lists and out of any pair (exchangeControlPairProblem, which the engine also asks).
